text_block_list.text:
WE COME IN PEACE, EARTHLINGS! PUT YOUR 
HANDS UP!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding~! That was an impression from 
an alien comedy sketch I saw yesterday~!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ASEM"—there are no "brethren." It's "I 
knew it all along"...

Neo Universe felt isolated and grew 
disheartened……
